name: Parrillas (Spain)
description: Quartered blue and white, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Parrillas (a tree on yellow and a chequy).
history: The arms were approved by the Real Academia de la Historia at its meeting of 22 June 1983; in 2017 a modification was begun that ended with its publication in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha of 23 April 2018 together with the approval of an official flag, described as a rectangular cloth whose length is one and a half times its height.

features.role: Parrillas arms — tree on yellow and a chequy of blue and white
